rationale: Fermenting lactate, glucose, and arginine (Stickland) under anaerobic conditions. Arginine provides both C and N. Products are acetate, butyrate, CO₂, and H₂ typical of mixed-acid fermentation. Growth rate supports biomass synthesis (~15 mmol C) with remaining carbon flowing to fermentation products. Nitrogen balance maintained via arginine, cysteine, and ammonium uptake.
